// GREEN fixture for `tenant-predicate` — the lint MUST admit this.
// The query threads the tenant predicate through the RLS guard: every query-builder call
// carries a TenantId bound, so a cross-tenant read is impossible.
pub async fn list_principals(pool: &Pool, tenant_id: TenantId) -> Vec<Principal> {
    sqlx::query("SELECT id, email FROM principals")
        .with_tenant(tenant_id)
        .fetch_all(pool)
        .await
        .unwrap()
}
